title: Front pipette incorrectly lifts the dropper head out of view
surfaces: PDP and Builder after candidate integration
reproduction: Compose a clear Boston15 extraction with its photographed front pipette. shoulderLiftMm uses the pipette tip as closure reach, lifting the hardware above the canvas. Reproduced on all six clear dropper source candidates.
proposedRepair: Exclude pipette tips from the closure reach calculation while preserving their movement with the attached front closure.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropper head placement unchanged when its internal pipette is added
All six clear candidates retain their heads in offline CAP ON output
Amber, cobalt and short-cap placements unchanged
Verify supported PDP and Builder views after catalogue and artwork approval
scopeNote: 6 source candidates; 1 matching records in saved catalogue. No current served configuration is claimed broken by these unshipped layers.
